prompt: Read-only engineering consultation: diagnose why a four-character language-model conversation remains trapped in abstract talk about narratives, conversation, systems, and metaphor despite an active conversational floor. Propose at most three testable, mechanistic changes that make turns responsive and grounded in concrete situations, without simply using keyword bans, scripted dialogue, mandatory quotas, or pretending a code merge proves success. Audit current repository files scripts/room_chat_speech.py, scripts/room_conversational_floor.py, scripts/room_hidden_world.py, .github/workflows/sarah-society.yml, and relevant validation tests. Distinguish causal hypotheses from evidence. For each proposed change give a falsifiable test and failure mode. Address whether a non-omniscient four-party shared-world event plus private observations is promising or likely to degrade into meta-talk.
context: Public baseline last 100 turns: 69 broadly meta/system/narrative terms; 39 question endings, without sustained new concrete development. The Llama 3.2 3B native selected speech path is currently active, but private thought/comprehension inference is skipped to avoid CPU timeouts. Speech prompt includes only last three turns.

An opt-in finite 100-turn trial has injected different fictional private observations per person; first 10 test turns gave one radio mention but 8/10 still contained broad meta/narrative terms. A second sparse environmental event experiment is scheduled for pre-state cycles 35175 and 35220 to introduce new events after last utterance, with independent observations. Do not assume it succeeded.

Prior logs show timeout/restart loop; a capacity change merged and the live feed is updating again. A human observer wants meaningful responsive naturalistic conversation and dislikes superficial rephrasing or claims based only on merged code.
expected_response: Prioritized precise diagnosis, strongest mechanism with implementation-level suggestions, counterexamples, and a 100-turn A/B validation plan with measurable genuine dialogue quality, with sources or code locations where possible.
